components.name: Robert-cargocats-aiservice
components.description: Robert-cargocats-aiservice is a Java Spring Boot microservice that appears to provide AI/chat functionality as a backend for the Robert-cargocats-frontgateservice gateway. It exposes an endpoint that accepts requests and forwards them to a language model via an OpenAI-compatible client, acting as an internal AI integration layer within the CargoCats application suite.
